## Checklist

- [ ] The frontmatter `name` matches the skill's folder name exactly.
- [ ] The `description` says what it does and ends with a "Trigger when…" clause.
- [ ] Every step uses the `flowleap` CLI — no in-app typed tool names (e.g. `search_patents(...)`).
- [ ] Any reference to another skill is optional (still makes sense if that skill is not installed).
- [ ] No version numbers, dates, or other information that will go out of date.
- [ ] I added a **new** skill folder and did **not** edit any existing (synced) `SKILL.md`.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally.
